headline: European Stocks Slip as Trump Issues Waiver on Certain Russian Sanctions
summary: European equities declined as investors reacted to President Trump signing an executive order waiving certain sanctions on Russian energy revenues.
why: European markets are heavily sensitive to geopolitical shifts and energy supply regulations, which directly influence regional corporate earnings and inflation expectations.

impacts.name: European Equities
impacts.why: Geopolitical uncertainties and regional protests pressure stock valuations across European exchanges.

why_moved: Changes in U.S. sanctions policy alter global energy supply dynamics, creating volatility across international equity markets.
